title: Google Recommendations AI - Vertex AI Search for commerce
clean_text: Google Recommendations AI, now rebranded as Vertex AI Search for commerce, is a fully managed machine learning service on Google Cloud for product recommendations and search ranking. It uses Google's deep learning models trained on retail-specific data patterns. Integrates with Google Analytics, Merchant Center, and the broader Google Cloud ecosystem. Targets mid-to-large retailers requiring scalable recommendation infrastructure. Purely API-based with no plug-and-play storefront UI. Requires engineering resources for catalog data ingestion, user event tracking, and model management.
